subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Read 12-hour time in hours and half hours; use an analogue clock to tell time

show.line: The short hand points to the hour. The long hand on twelve means o'clock. Three o'clock!

rounds.praise: Yes! Short hand on seven, long hand on twelve.

rounds.prompt: The long hand points to six. Which clock shows half past two?
Look at the clock. What time is it? Say the time.
School starts at eight o'clock. Which clock shows eight o'clock?
O'clock or half past? Put each clock in its group.

rounds.story: Lunch starts at twelve o'clock and ends at one o'clock. How long is lunch?
rounds.praise: One hour! From twelve to one.

rounds.prompt: It is half past four. Which digital clock matches?
rounds.praise: Yes! Four thirty is half past four.

hints: Short hand is the hour. Long hand on twelve is o'clock, on six is half past.
Half past means the long hand is halfway round.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this clock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The long hand is on six and the short hand is near five. Six o'clock!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The long hand on six means half past. Half past four.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Long hand on six, half past. Short hand just past four. Half past four!

parent_line: Can read o'clock and half past on an analogue clock.
